name: text-scan
description: Static prose scanner for text you are about to trust (fetched pages, pasted documents, tool output, memory content). Flags prompt-injection phrasing (e.g. instructions to disregard prior context, fake embedded tool-call markup, chat-template role overrides, instructions to send data to an external URL) and suspicious invisible/bidi Unicode characters used to hide text. Deliberately narrower than a general security scanner: command-shaped concerns (piped installers, destructive shell commands, credential exfiltration) are already covered by Foreman's own admission gate and are not duplicated here. Never executes or evaluates the scanned text.

mode.description: 'markdown' additionally annotates findings that fall inside a fenced code block. Defaults to 'text'.

worst.description: The worst severity across ALL findings, even ones dropped by the 'findings' cap below.

truncated.description: True if more than 200 findings were found and the 'findings' array was capped.

totalFindings.description: The true total number of findings, before the 200-item cap on the 'findings' array.
